references.text: The Jubilee year is mentioned as the time when property must be returned, which is relevant for evaluating a purchased field that is dedicated to the Lord.
It deals with rules for buying and selling land and its return in the Jubilee year, forming the basis for the rule concerning purchased fields as opposed to ancestral inheritance.
The preceding verse concerns the dedication of ancestral land to the Lord, which stands in contrast to the purchased field mentioned in verse 22.
The continuation describes how the value of the purchased field is to be calculated and what happens to it in the Jubilee year.
It mentions the Jubilee year in connection with the transfer of property between tribes, which is relevant for understanding purchased land versus ancestral inheritance.
